name: pnpm-turbo-monorepo-template-setup-local
description: Runs the shared workspace-initializer, then removes this repo's one-time setup gate (setup/guard.mjs and its call sites) so nothing template-specific survives into the generated project.

tasks.name: Remove setup script (handled locally)
tasks.description: Disabled: the shared task targets the old inline unpkg command. scripts.setup is removed JSON-side by remove-setup-guard instead. The config below is a never-matching no-op, present only because the schema requires it.

tasks.name: Remove setup guard
tasks.description: Strip the setup gate from package.json, .husky/pre-commit and README.md, then delete the setup/ folder

tasks.name: Create first package
tasks.description: Redeclared so cleanup runs BEFORE it: the CLI runs configs in sequential mode, where the last task with a given id wins. required:false keeps a generator failure from stranding the cleanup.

tasks.name: Reinstall dependencies
tasks.description: Run after cleanup so the removed postinstall guard is not re-triggered
